title: Moriti o ka Mora Terone
intro: U eme ka har'a makhotla a 'muso o moholo oa boholo-holo, moo 'musi ea matla a iphatlalalitseng e le molimo holim'a batho bohle. Pel'a 'musi enoa ho eme mohlanka ea inehetseng, ea filoeng litabatabelo tse kholo ka ho fetisisa tsa 'muso. Hammoho, ba rera le ho rera, ba hana ho ela hloko litemoso tsa lenģosa le rometsoeng ho ba tataisa. Na u ka senola hore na mohlanka enoa ea tšepahalang e ne e le mang?
clues: Ke ne ke phela 'musong o matla o busoang ke motho ea matla ea neng a ipolela hore ke Molimo holim'a batho bohle.
Ke sebeleditse jwalo ka moruti ya tshepahalang wa mmusi enwa, ke phethahatsa ditabatabelo le ditaelo tsohle tsa hae.
Ha lenģosa la Allah le fihla naheng ea rona le re bitsa 'neteng, 'na le 'musi oa ka re ile ra hana ho mamela.
Ke ile ka laeloa ho hotetsa mollo o moholo le ho lokisa litene tsa letsopa bakeng sa kaho e kholo.
’Musi oa ka o ne a batla ho haha ​​mohaho o molelele hoo o neng o tla fihla maholimong ka boona.
Qetellong, ’na, ’musi oa ka, mabotho a rona, le ’na re ile ra hoholeha ’me ra khangoa ke metsi botebong ba leoatle.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
